# Avalon 721 packing instructions

Source: Canaan-Creative/avalon7-docs, `avalonminer-721-packaging-instructions-1.0-cn.pdf`.
Original: `work/vendors/doc-extract/avalonminer-721-packaging-instructions-1.0-cn.pdf`.
Archive: `vendors-canaan-avalon7-docs`.
Language: Chinese to English. Translation date: 2026-10-19.
Scope: Complete translation of the document text and figure captions. The 24 photographs are in the original PDF. Graphics are not redrawn. Text inside photographs has not been separately checked.
Review: AI translation. A technical reviewer has not checked it.

Packing materials: one cardboard box and two EPE foam pads.

1. Unfolded cardboard box.
2. Reverse side of the unfolded cardboard box.
3. Top EPE foam pad.
4. Bottom EPE foam pad.

Accessories:

5. AUC3 converter.
6. AUC3 data cable.
7. Antistatic bag.
8. Instruction card.
9. AUC converter with its label.
10. AUC3 data cable with its label.

Fold the cardboard box:

11. Bottom of the cardboard box.

Labels:

12. Product label.
13. Sticker for the outside of the packing bag.

Attach the label to the device:

14. Attach the label to the front of the device.

Wrap the device with heat-shrink film:

15. Wrap the outside of the device with heat-shrink film.

Attach the label to the film:

16. Attach the label to the side of the heat-shrink film.

Put the device in the box:

17. Put the bottom EPE foam pad in the bottom of the box.
18. Put the Avalon device in the box.
19. Put the top EPE foam pad in position.

Put the accessories in the box:

20. Put the data cable and converter in the box.
21. Put the Welcome Card in the box.

Mark the packing list:

22. Mark the packing list with a red pen.

Seal the box:

23. Photograph of the sealed box.
24. Completed package.
